sloka: अहम् हि ते लक्ष्मण नित्यमेव ।जानामि भक्तिम् च पराक्रमम् च ।मम त्वभिप्राय मसन्निरीक्ष्य ।मात्रा सहाभ्यर्दसि मा सुदुःखम् ॥२-२१-५५॥
transliteration: aham hi te lakṣmaṇa nityameva ।jānāmi bhaktim ca parākramam ca ।mama tvabhiprāya masannirīkṣya ।mātrā sahābhyardasi mā suduḥkham ॥2-21-55॥

translations.english: I know your devotion (to me) and your valour, O Lakshmana But now, without understanding my intention you are causing me and mother severe pain and torment.
